description: Declare the failures Forgejo's organization endpoints produce in practice but the Swagger document leaves out. The list endpoints (teams, team members, Actions secrets and variables) answer 403 for a credential that is not a member of the organization, exactly as the sibling repository lists do — undeclared, that surfaces as an out-of-union Forbidden a caller cannot handle without loosening types. createOrgRepo answers 409 for a repository name already taken under the organization, the same conflict createCurrentUserRepo does declare; without it a concurrent-create race cannot be recovered as an adoption.
